summary: P0 Blocker Security Hardening MFA tests completed successfully. All 17 backend tests passed, 1 skipped due to brute-force lockout from previous test runs. Frontend login pages properly handle MFA challenge response with grace_ack button support.
critical_code_review_comments: MFA implementation is solid with proper challenge-based login flow
Device binding via httpOnly cookie is correctly implemented in deps.py
JWT claims include mfa_verified and device_id as required
Brute-force protection triggers after 5 failures with 30-minute lockout
TOTP anti-replay detection uses timecode-based hash comparison
Step-up freshness check enforces 10-minute window for critical operations
Grace period flow allows privileged users 24h to setup MFA
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 Blocker Security Hardening features fully tested. Backend endpoints verified: POST /api/auth/login/admin (returns mfa_required=true, no access_token), POST /api/mfa/verify, POST /api/auth/mfa/verify, POST /api/auth/mfa/challenge/verify (all MFA verification endpoints work), POST /api/auth/step-up (requires auth). Device binding verified via deps.py (token-cookie mismatch rejection). Brute-force lockout after 5 failures (423 status). Critical endpoints requiring step-up: /api/user/exchange/connect, /api/user/exchange-connections (POST/PUT/DELETE), /api/user/open-position, /api/user/execute-order, /api/user/manual-trade, /api/user/funds/withdraw-request, /api/v1/user/trading/execute, /api/user/execution/position-actions/submit, /api/user/execution/intent/submit. Frontend AdminLoginPage.jsx properly handles MFA challenge with grace_ack button (data-testid='admin-login-mfa-grace-continue-button').
